shots.kf: Wide shot of the Skopje city skyline at dawn, with the silhouette of Mount Vodno in the distant background. Thick morning mist rolls gently over the Vardar river. Soft blue and warm orange morning light illuminates the mix of brutalist and modern architecture. Premium cinematic 35mm lens, atmospheric, highly detailed, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow pan right across the cityscape, while the thick morning mist rolls gently above the river surface.

shots.kf: Over-the-shoulder shot of a silhouette of a person standing by a large glass window in a modern office, looking out at the waking city. Soft interior warm lighting contrasts with the cool blue hour outside. Shot on a 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, premium cinematic lighting, highly detailed, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow push-in toward the person's silhouette, with subtle light reflections shifting slowly on the glass surface.

shots.kf: Close-up of a steaming ceramic coffee mug resting on a clean wooden desk. In the beautifully blurred background, glowing monitor screens cast a soft blue and green light across the room. High-end commercial lighting, 85mm macro lens, rich colors, deep shadows, cinematic atmosphere, highly detailed, perfectly photorealistic.
shots.motion: Steam rises gently and naturally from the coffee cup, while the camera executes a slow, smooth slide to the left.

shots.kf: Medium shot of a sleek server rack inside a clean, modern data room. Glowing blue and teal indicator lights blink rhythmically in the shadows. Cold, precise studio lighting, 24mm lens, perfect geometric and symmetrical composition, conveying stability and power, highly detailed textures, completely photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow tilt up the server rack, as the indicator lights softly glow and shift intensity in a rhythmic pattern.

shots.kf: Wide shot of an empty modern lounge area in a Skopje tech hub. Sleek minimalist furniture, a large green potted plant, and warm morning sunlight streaming through massive floor-to-ceiling windows. 24mm lens, architectural photography style, clean lines, serene atmosphere, high dynamic range, highly detailed, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Sunbeams slowly move across the wooden floor, while the camera executes a slow dolly back through the empty room.

shots.kf: Medium shot of an abstract glowing optical fiber bundle in a completely dark room. Warm gold and bright blue lights are traveling through the thick clear cables. Macro lens, deep shadows, high contrast, cinematic corporate aesthetic, conveying data and connectivity, highly detailed, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow rotation around the fiber cables, with the golden and blue light pulsing gently and traveling inside them.

vo_mk: Време е за твојот следен голем предизвик!

shots.kf: Vertical composition. A glowing, floating holographic 3D cube in the center of a dark, modern industrial brick room. Neon purple and cyan backlighting creates a striking contrast. Subject is perfectly centered. 24mm wide angle, aggressive lighting, moody cyber aesthetic, highly detailed, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The glowing holographic cube rotates slowly and smoothly on its axis, while the camera slowly pushes in toward it.

shots.kf: Vertical composition. A sleek matte black pair of premium wireless headphones resting on a minimalist concrete desk. Vibrant orange ambient light is spilling from the edge of the frame, highlighting the curves. Centered subject, 50mm lens, commercial product photography style, highly detailed, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow cinematic orbit around the headphones, with the warm orange light reflecting softly on the matte black surface.

shots.kf: Vertical composition. A bright glowing neon arrow pointing upward, mounted on a raw concrete wall in a stylish tech office. High contrast, cinematic lighting, deep shadows, rich saturated colors. Subject perfectly centered in the frame. 35mm lens, urban tech aesthetic, highly detailed, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The neon light flickers slightly, while the camera executes a smooth, slow tilt up following the direction of the arrow.

shots.kf: Top-down overhead view of a perfectly organized minimalist white desk featuring neat stacks of blank blueprint paper and a sleek metallic pen. Soft, diffused overhead daylight creates gentle, elegant shadows across the surface. Clean, clinical, symmetrical composition, 50mm lens, conveying organization and precise planning, highly detailed, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow push-in toward the exact center of the white desk, causing the soft shadows to shift slightly across the paper.

shots.kf: Wide shot of a bright, spacious modern meeting room in Skopje with glass walls and no people. A clean whiteboard on the wall reflects the morning sun. 24mm lens, architectural lighting, clean corporate aesthetic, modern minimalist furniture, highly detailed, realistic textures, completely photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow dolly right parallel to the modern glass wall, with gentle sunlight flaring softly through the large windows.

shots.kf: Close-up of floating abstract geometric glass shapes in mid-air, refracting bright blue and white light. A strong visual metaphor for complex software architecture and coding structures. Dark background, premium studio lighting, 85mm macro lens, highly detailed glass textures, cinematic corporate style, perfectly photorealistic.
shots.motion: The glass geometric shapes slowly rotate and hover in place, refracting the studio light dynamically across their surfaces.

shots.kf: Medium shot of a sleek, modern robotic arm in a pristine clean laboratory setting, symbolizing advanced automation and modern technology. Soft teal and white lighting highlights the metallic joints. 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, futuristic but grounded aesthetic, highly detailed, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The sleek robotic arm smoothly and slowly pivots on its sturdy base, while the camera remains completely static.

shots.kf: Macro shot of a shiny heavy metallic padlock resting on top of a dark, textured server chassis, strongly representing cybersecurity and data protection. Blue LED lights are glowing softly in the blurred background. 100mm macro lens, cinematic contrast, premium commercial lighting, highly detailed, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Slow camera slide to the right, while the blue server lights twinkle softly out of focus in the background.

shots.kf: Medium shot of a large, blank digital dashboard screen securely mounted on a dark modern wall. The pristine screen emits a soft, pulsing golden light that warmly illuminates the surrounding dark wall texture. 35mm lens, minimalist composition, corporate tech environment, highly detailed, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The soft golden light slowly pulses in brightness on the screen, accompanied by a very slow camera zoom out.

shots.kf: Wide shot of a sleek, futuristic high-speed train moving across a modern concrete bridge, symbolizing fast product delivery and technological progress. Bright midday daylight, clear blue sky over a scenic Macedonian landscape. 24mm lens, dynamic high-angle perspective, rich vibrant colors, highly detailed, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The sleek train glides smoothly across the frame from left to right, with a slow camera pan tracking its movement.
